name: Tavrimo Unified Local Calendar & Profile
features: single local calendar pool for Today and Week
manual multi-file iCalendar import from Today
recurring daily, weekly, monthly and yearly iCalendar event expansion
migration of former REA events into a local calendar
preservation of original event IDs and linkedUniversityEventId task references
idempotent migration with collision and invalid-event safeguards
preservation of previously downloaded external calendar snapshots
clear legacy Google/Outlook/iCloud feed URLs and disable automatic refresh
no automatic REA or calendar-feed requests on startup, online, visibilitychange, pageshow or timer
local profile with display name and compressed local avatar
Statistics and Plan Health accessible from Profile
More navigation limited to Profile, Focus and Settings
JSON backup compatibility with schema v17
offline-first PWA with versioned Service Worker cache
notes: Tavrimo 12.4.0 uses manual local .ics imports. Existing REA timetable events are migrated into a local calendar with original IDs preserved so task links remain valid. Previously downloaded external feed events are retained locally while private feed URLs are cleared. No background schedule or external feed synchronization is performed. Profile name and compressed avatar remain in local browser data and are included in JSON backups.
summary: Unified local calendar, Today .ics import and local profile. Preserves schema v17, prior event IDs, task links, focus history and JSON backups.
design: Tavrimo dark visual system with the existing original brand assets; no broad redesign.
